affiliations.role_title: spacebuyer; later described as media director
affiliations.date_precision: Employment reported as preceding an Army commission in October 1942; exact start and end dates unknown
affiliations.research_notes: A contemporary 1942 trade paper gives George C. Dibert's full name, J. Walter Thompson job, and new Army captain commission. Soley's scholarly history independently connects a J. Walter Thompson media director George Dibert to OSS Morale Operations and refers to Major Dibert. This supports the indexed major row's last civilian employer before military service, not an immediate Army-to-OSS predecessor. The adjacent unnumbered index row remains a separate possible duplicate pending Box 185 review.

claims.claim_text: The indexed Major George C Dibert is a high-confidence match to the advertising professional George C. Dibert described in a 1942 trade paper and to the OSS Major Dibert discussed by Lawrence C. Soley.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The 1942 item identifies George C. Dibert as an Army Specialist Corps captain and J. Walter Thompson spacebuyer; Soley links George Dibert, a Thompson media director, to OSS Morale Operations and refers to him as a major.
claims.identity_match_assessment: High confidence from uncommon full name, Army officer progression from captain to indexed major, shared advertising employer, and an independently described OSS major. No original personnel file or protected-identifier crosswalk has been reviewed.
claims.temporal_assessment: The Army commission is reported in October 1942; Soley dates a subsequent OSS Morale Operations leadership role to August 1944. Exact OSS entry date remains unverified.
claims.match_notes: This claim concerns the numbered major row only. The adjacent unnumbered George C Dibert remains separate and may be a duplicate; it is not automatically assigned the biography or employer.

claims.claim_text: J. Walter Thompson Co. was the last documented civilian employer of the indexed Major George C Dibert before his wartime Army service.
claims.evidence_excerpt: GEORGE C. DIBERT, spacebuyer of J. Walter Thompson Co., New York.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: A contemporary trade-paper item reports George C. Dibert's agency job and Army captain commission together; Soley independently identifies the OSS George Dibert as a Thompson media director before joining OSS.
claims.identity_match_assessment: High for the indexed major row: uncommon full name, compatible wartime officer ranks, and scholarly OSS/agency corroboration. The adjacent unnumbered row is unresolved.
claims.temporal_assessment: The 1942 publication explicitly places Thompson employment at the Army commission; Soley states the Thompson role preceded OSS. The immediate pre-OSS military or institutional assignment is not established.
claims.match_notes: Count once as last civilian employer before service. Do not present J. Walter Thompson as the immediate pre-OSS affiliation, and do not transfer the claim to the separate unnumbered row without file review.
